topic.readerProblem: Explain exactly which brand mention, recommendation, rank, availability, and citation fields changed between two answer snapshots.
topic.connection: Row-level snapshot diffs make AEO visibility changes auditable before AEOeye-style results are aggregated into rates or stability scores.

assessment: The page delivers a deterministic row-level comparator with populated before and after snapshots. It separates prompt-set gaps from measured zeroes and exposes scalar and citation-domain changes without claiming a provider caused them or that either coded answer is correct.

sources.supports: The timestamp syntax recommended for preserving collection dates and time zones.
The provenance relationship between raw snapshots, collection activity, and derived diffs.
The context-dependent nature of AI measurement and evaluation stated in the guide.
The standard-library JSON decoder used for populated snapshot inputs.
The standard-library CSV writer used for deterministic row-level output.

checks: Executed the comparator against before.json and after.json and byte-compared every generated row with expected-diff.csv.
Manually recomputed the rank move, recommendation changes, availability change, citation additions and removals, and both prompt-set gaps from the two JSON files.
Read the final article, checked all sources and resource links, and corrected the second image attribution and literal alt description.

artifacts.description: Dependency-free comparator keyed by prompt ID and engine with scalar, domain, and gap outputs.
Populated synthetic baseline containing five prompt-engine answer records.
Populated synthetic comparison snapshot with changed, removed, and added records.
Deterministic checked change log for byte-level regression comparison.
Runnable commands and an explicit boundary between detected differences and causal claims.

methodology: The editorial review parsed both populated JSON fixtures, manually traced their union of prompt and engine keys, recomputed each scalar and set difference, ran the standard-library implementation, and compared the generated CSV bytes with the checked expected output.
limitations: The tool cannot retrieve answers, detect why they changed, validate source support, prove provider causality, repair changed sampling, or make ranks comparable across answer surfaces.
